hypothetical_configuration_estimates.analytic_gate_verdict: FEASIBLE within this model (physically hypothetical scale)
hypothetical_configuration_estimates.verdict_caveat: Within-model analytic screen only; not real-world feasibility or hardware evidence.

selected_single_enablers.name: Access to a finite 3e22 kg asteroid
selected_single_enablers.selection_reason: Without reaction mass the modeled recoil mechanism cannot transfer momentum to Earth.
selected_single_enablers.scope: A stated asteroid mass reservoir is available as reaction mass; the simulated launch packets are finite and Earth recoils when they are ejected. This is one resource-access assumption, not a launcher-system bundle.
selected_single_enablers.gap: No asteroid is actually captured or docked; access to and placement of a 3e22 kg body is far beyond demonstrated capability.

supporting_components.name: Launch ring + 8 launch arms (mass driver)
supporting_components.use: Accelerates each packet to the commanded speed in the commanded direction; all 8 arms (each 2 R_E long, roots on a 1.25 R_E ring) throw one packet together.

supporting_components.name: Arm power conditioning + energy reserve
supporting_components.use: Turns the arm electricity into launch energy; a reserve covers launches when the beams are short.

supporting_components.name: Directional arm radiators
supporting_components.use: Reject the launcher and rectenna waste heat to space, away from Earth.

selected_single_enablers.name: Thin-film photovoltaic collector field
selected_single_enablers.selection_reason: The modeled mission needs a physical energy source; sunlight is traced through panel conversion and the downstream ledger.
selected_single_enablers.scope: Five million thin-film collectors at 0.5 AU intercept the configured 30 % of the Sun's output and convert sunlight into electricity. This is one power-generation enabler; microwave transmitters, rectennas and factories are supporting components, not bundled enablers.
selected_single_enablers.gap: A Dyson-swarm-scale photovoltaic field (~1e13 x all solar panels ever built); collector area and mass are far beyond industry. The power-transfer chain separately assumes about 1e24 W over 0.5-3 AU, pointing near 1e-12 rad, and rectenna beam intensity around 2e8 times sunlight.

supporting_components.name: Microwave phased-array transmitter (one per collector)
supporting_components.use: Turns the electricity into a focused 5.8 GHz beam aimed at the arms; suppresses side lobes so spill misses Earth.

supporting_components.name: Rectenna on each of the 8 arm tips
supporting_components.use: Receives the microwaves and turns them back into electricity for the launcher.

supporting_components.name: Sail-tilt station keeping (on each collector)
supporting_components.use: Uses part of the light-pressure push to hold the collector in its slot (no propellant).

supporting_components.name: Clear sunlight lane
supporting_components.use: Collectors leave a moving gap so Earth and Mars see the whole Sun.

supporting_components.name: Collector factories (Mercury material)
supporting_components.use: Build the belt up and replace aged panels.

selected_single_enablers.name: Space-mirror ring
selected_single_enablers.selection_reason: Without added reflected sunlight, the simplified climate model falls into a cold state at the target orbit.
selected_single_enablers.scope: A single mirror-ring technology reflects sunlight; the configured 1.6e15 m^2 film area can supply up to 1.10 x today's sunlight at 2.7 AU in the climate model. The agent sets the light level.
selected_single_enablers.gap: Plain reflection is known physics, but the configured 1.6e15 m^2 and formation flight/pointing are far beyond industry; this is not a physical deployment design.

supporting_components.name: Terminator orbit at 20 Earth radii + pointing (45 degree tilt)
supporting_components.use: Keeps the mirrors in sunlight and aims their light at Earth or past it (the agent's action a4).

validation_status.claim: No current-version PPO success or hardware certification is claimed.

required_context: Physical estimates, reward and training performance are separate. Simulated years are not wall-clock time.
